mainEntity.name: How long does a full bathroom renovation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a full bathroom renovation typically ranges from a few weeks to several months, depending on the scope of work and availability of materials. Demolition, rough-in plumbing and electrical, inspections, tile installation, fixture placement, and finishing touches all contribute to the duration. Unexpected issues can also extend the project. We provide a projected timeline with our detailed proposals.
